points: Staging over four weeks is sensible after a 5-day, 19% chip slide: nobody knows if day five is the bottom.
NVDA, TSM and AVGO have the strongest fundamentals in the sell-off (revenue +51% to +106%, 15x forward or less) and their 200-day averages are still rising or flat.
MU's 3x forward P/E is a cycle-peak signal, not a bargain signal; ALAB and CRDO are fast growers with broken charts.
NVIDIA's Nov 17 earnings are the biggest single event inside the month.

debates.bull: Policy fear, not earnings, caused the drop; the leaders are at multi-year-low valuations.
NVDA/TSM/AVGO are the best of the group; the ETF carries weaker names.
debates.bear: TSM and AVGO are one bet on hyperscaler budgets; SMH spreads it and avoids single-earnings shocks.

debates.bull: MSFT, ISRG, GE barely fell, so they're not on sale.
debates.bear: They fell less because their earnings don't depend on AI capex, which is exactly the protection.
